The kiln district assembles its three brothers: §3the Reinforced Brick Blast Furnace, the Large Coke Oven and the Crust Steam Borer§r — three machines, three temperaments.

The blast furnace's §3heat§r is the delicate one: it climbs while running, sags while idle, and once the fire is right, speed and parallelism rise together — never let it go cold. The coke oven heats slowly and cools even slower, a game of patience; the borer speeds up outright on superheated and rolls its ores from a void-drop table.

The details differ; the common point does not: all three must be fed.

§8§oFire all three and the neighbors think you brew elixirs.§r
